We need propose a retrosynthesis route with at most 1 step (i.e., a single reaction) from commercially available precursors, total price <= $150. We have identified a template (ID 223474) that matches target. The reactant SMILES from that template: Br[c:10]1[cH:11][cH:12][c:13]([CH3:14])[cH:15][cH:16]1 . O=[C:2]([CH3:1])[c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][c:6]([CH3:7])[cH:8][cH:9]1

Interpret: Two fragments: a bromobenzene with a methyl substituent (para? Actually Br attached to aromatic ring with a methyl). And an acetyl phenyl with a methyl substituent (i.e., p-methyl phenyl ketone? Let's decode: O=C(C) - that's acetyl attached to aromatic ring with a methyl substituent (maybe p-methyl phenyl). So the product is a stilbene with two anisole (methoxy) groups? Wait target: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. That's trans-stilbene where each phenyl has a methoxy para? Actually each phenyl has OCH3 at para position relative to the double bond? The SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. So central C=C attached to two phenyl rings each bearing OCH3 at para position (maybe meta?). The template uses bromobenzene with methyl and acetophenone with methyl. That seems not directly matching methoxy groups. But template may be generic: the aromatic substituents can be varied. However the reactants we need to be commercially available: we could use 4-bromoanisole (bromo with OMe) and 4-methoxyacetophenone? Let's see if those match the pattern: The template expects a bromophenyl (with maybe any substituent) and an aryl ketone (aryl-CO-CH3). Our target has no carbonyl; the template is a Heck-type coupling? Actually product is alkene formed from bromobenzene and acetophenone after elimination of CO? Wait the template seems to convert bromobenzene + acetophenone to stilbene via a Heck-type? The product SMILES from template: [CH2]=[C]... Actually product is a substituted alkene with aromatic groups. So the reactants are bromobenzene and acetophenone (aryl methyl ketone). The reaction likely is a McMurry? Not sure.

We need to ensure precursors are commercially available and total price <=150. We can check buyability of 4-bromoanisole (c1ccc(OC)cc1Br) which we already checked is buyable. Also 4-methoxyacetophenone (COc1ccc(C=O)cc1) is buyable (we checked COc1ccc(C=O)cc1 is True). So those two are buyable.

Now we need to verify that applying template 223474 to these reactants yields target. Let's test apply_template with those SMILES.
